explanation: geneVocabulary.ts binds a gene selection to one or more vocabularies: case policy (stored spelling, upper-case across studies), shared nomenclature authority (null for mixed species) and per-chip facts. useGeneSelection gains replace(), used by restoreAnalysis; state and RESET_MATRIX resets stay in the explorer session. geneChips asks nothing of a source with no authority, so no chip borrows a namespace its study never used.
